critical_code_review_comments: server.py `norm_phone` collapses to '628...' only when input starts with '0'. International numbers already in '+62…' form (user types '+628…') pass through re.sub(r'\D','') -> '628…' which matches canonical form, OK. But phones like '812…' (no leading 0 or 62) stay as '812…' and will NOT merge with '0812…' or '62812…'. Low likelihood but worth normalising when len==9-11 and leading digit is '8'.

/api/clients iterates all bookings in memory on EVERY request (`db.bookings.find().to_list(50000)`). Fine at current scale but will degrade; add a simple cache keyed by last booking updated_at or paginate.

`build_clients` sets `last_visit`/`last_package` on every booking where `date <= today` without comparing dates, so the sort by date asc + overwrite leaves the latest past booking as last_visit (correct). But `total_spent` uses `b['price']`, not `paid_total` — a cancelled-and-re-created flow with abandoned bookings could inflate it. Code comment should clarify intent.

booking/[id].tsx line 65 passes `b.client_phone` to openWhatsApp without trimming; if phone is empty the helper throws 'Nomor WhatsApp belum diisi' (confirmed in flow). Consider showing error inline per-button rather than general ErrorText below cards for better affordance.

/api/bookings/{bid}/invoice does not check `payment_status` — invoices for cancelled bookings currently 404 (because cancel deletes booking). But a 'belum_bayar' invoice still prints — this matches the spec but UX may want a 'DRAFT' watermark.
